title: Sistem Perkongsian Fail Multimedia
summary: Organises media by multiple criteria, with role-based access and an approval workflow.
body:
A multimedia file sharing system that organises media by multiple criteria and controls who can see and publish it.

Built on Laravel, with a REST API and a React Native mobile client made with Expo.

highlights.title: Role-based access
highlights.text: What a person can view, upload or manage depends on their role.

highlights.title: Approval workflow
highlights.text: Media goes through approval before it is shared.

highlights.title: Mobile client
highlights.text: A React Native app built with Expo talks to the system over a REST API.
